Hi Marta — great to hear and thanks for the spec. Quick answers up front, then options:

Short answer: Net90 is not our default. We generally offer net30; in enterprise cases we can consider extended terms with commercial concessions.

Options we can offer (pick one preferred):
1) Net45 with monthly invoices (standard discount bands preserved).
2) Net60 with a temporary removal of the standard volume discount for the first quarter, reinstated on renewal.
3) Net90 only if Solstice agrees to either (a) 1.5% administrative fee on net90 invoices, or (b) pre-authorized commitment (advance credit) covering 2 months of expected spend.

Regarding PO formatting: please include a single top-level PO number field and the three custom fields in the invoice header (BU_CODE, Project_ID, GL_ACCOUNT). Our billing address and remittance instructions: billing@redwood.ai; Redwood, Inc. (Tax ID on MSA). I'll attach the MSA so procurement can review with the PO.

If you want, we can also do milestone invoicing tied to delivery dates (we'd need explicit dates in the PO).

Tell me which option you prefer and I'll loop in Finance for approval.

Thanks,
